notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: The floor of the online mode has been improved. A fix has been introduced to address an issue in the online mode that caused players to attack themselves. Fixed a car suit issue.

notes.title: Keyboard run key changes
notes.notes: The run button of keyboard has been changed to W and now the autorun it´s the default, you can turn it off on options on the middle of gameplay.

notes.title: Changes and Corrections
notes.notes:
-(Keyboard Controls) Now you will run only if you maintain pressed the key(you can change to auto-run mode changing this option on middle of gameplay on the pause screen menu)

-(First Stage) 2 Rocks of the first stage has been erased because it gave serious problems to very much players.

-(Triangle of K.O) A problem that caused to maintain all triangles of K.O after a new stage has been fixed.

-(Armors and Suit Selection Screen) Now it´s not any more randomized, only will be randomized if you choose the option to do it.

-(Online PVP Mode) This mode continues on development but will be available to play it very soon.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
-Fixed a problem that caused 3 stages to repeat themselves at the final part of the game, They have now been replaced by new ones and are no longer repeated.

 -One screen of text has been fixed, and now can be readed and understanded better in any language

notes.title: Graphics Quality and Lighting Changes/Fixes
notes.notes: Removed Strong Colors and Bad Textures, performance optimization improved, new update available now.
